sign-in.$description: Tokens for SignInDialog, AcmeCo's 'Log In/Sign Up' dialog (audit capture of the sign-in page and a reference screenshot): a promo carousel beside an email form, in the 768px dialog. Decision 31.

gap.$description: OBSERVED: 16px between the email field, Continue and the divider (576 - 560 = 16).

line.$description: OBSERVED: thin grey lines either side of 'or continue with'. Decorative.

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 16px light; became 14px regular, secondary like the contact form's notes.

size.$description: OBSERVED: 50 x 48px round buttons; 48px circles (4px grid).

gap.$description: OBSERVED: 21px between the circles (947 + 50 = 997, next at 1018); became 24px.

hover-background.$description: PROPOSED: the system hover grey (hover wasn't captured).

border.$description: OBSERVED: a thin light-grey outline (a reference screenshot); the 3:1 control grey, since each circle is a button.

text.$description: PROPOSED: the neutral placeholder mark in ink. AcmeCo shows each provider's logo, licensed only for real sign-in integrations (decision 31).

background.$description: OBSERVED: #f3f3f3 panel, the left half of the dialog.

padding.$description: PROPOSED: 24px, the dialog's padding (the panel reaches the dialog's edges).

gap.$description: OBSERVED: 16-20px between title, picture, text and dots.

title-font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: 400; semibold so each slide has a clear title.

current-width.$description: PROPOSED: the current slide's dot is a 16px pill, so it differs by shape as well as colour (WCAG 1.4.1).

target.$description: PROPOSED: a 24px target around each 8px dot (WCAG 2.5.8; AcmeCo's are 8px buttons).

color.$description: OBSERVED: #b2b2b2 (1.9:1 on the grey panel); became the 3:1 control grey, since each dot is a button.
